brief.headline: Close a 4 % price cut on the bottle SKU and qualify Manjushree as a second source — Berry is in distress, 100 % trader (reseller margin in price), and we're 7.21 % of their sales.

priceAsk.summary: Cut the LDPE bottle price from ₹1.69/NOS to ₹1.62/NOS (match Bprex) — save ₹3.37 L/yr. Push toward a maker's price: Berry is 100 % a trader, so their price carries a reseller margin.
priceAsk.target: ₹1.62/NOS for LDPE BOTTLE 5ML WHITE OPAQUE; total saving ₹3.37 L/yr
priceAsk.basis: Bprex Pharma Packaging India (P) Limited already gives us ₹1.62/NOS — a 4.3 % gap. Berry sells 100.0 % traded goods (not made by them), so benchmark to a manufacturer's price and strip out the reseller margin.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep the current 30 days after receipt — do NOT extend it. They already take 226 days to pay their own suppliers (far longer than the 41 days similar firms take), so asking us for more time would be unfair.

brief.financialLeverage: Berry is in the distress zone (Altman Z -0.18) and lost ₹-22.50 Cr in FY2023-24 (keeping -199.2 % profit vs 2.3 % for similar firms). They owe 220.44 times their own cash and their money-health score is 1 out of 10. We are 7.21 % of their ₹11.29 Cr revenue — real buying power. But pushing too hard on price could tip a fragile supplier over, so lead with supply-security (qualify a second source) and link any price cut to a six-month volume commitment to keep them stable.

evidence.point: Berry is in the distress zone
They are 100 % a trader — their price has a reseller margin built in
We pay ₹3.37 L/yr more than our cheapest supplier for the same type of items
evidence.figure: Total extra vs best price we pay ₹3.37 L

evidence.point: We are a big customer to them
evidence.figure: Our ₹81.39 L is 7.21 % of their ₹11.29 Cr sales

evidence.point: They take far longer to pay their own suppliers than similar firms do

alternates.name: Manjushree Technopack Ltd
alternates.why: India's largest rigid-plastic packaging converter (₹2569.83 Cr revenue, health B 65/100) — pharma bottles, caps, preforms. Top second-source candidate already qualified for packaging.

alternates.name: Mold-Tek Packaging Ltd
alternates.why: Listed rigid-plastic leader (₹946.50 Cr revenue, health B 73/100) — pails, containers, pharma. Strong, profitable alternate for bottles and closures, already a second source for packaging.

risks: Berry's distress-zone score and -199.2 % profit mean supply could go wobbly — don't load more volume onto them until a second source is live.
They owe 220.44 times their own cash and have a 1/10 money-health score — a hard price squeeze could push them over the edge.
Their cash is stuck for 335 days (vs 70 for similar firms), so they're already stretched — balance the price ask with a clear volume commitment.
100 % trader status means no manufacturing control — if their upstream maker has a problem, our supply stops immediately.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We'd like to close the 4.3 % gap to ₹1.62/NOS on the bottle SKU and talk about a six-month volume plan — can we also visit your maker to understand the supply chain better?
